answer: Each agent runs inside a hardware enclave that signs a fresh measurement at boot, and a recruit's bond burns if the enclave is caught emulating. Jury quorum must span subnetworks that share no ridge of infrastructure, so one compromised host cannot carry a vote. An attacker repeating the same voyage of fake registrations needs one real enclave per identity plus a network path far from ours, and the burn rate kills the ember of profit before the tenth clone.
